name: Show HN: pi pod – run your pi coding agent in sandboxes on your own server
description: pi pod runs sessions of the pi coding agent (https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) in isolated sandboxes ("pods") on a server you run, so an agent can work on a repo without touching your machine.
